title: SpaceX makes Nasdaq debut at $150 after pricing at $135: Live updates (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: SpaceX makes Nasdaq debut at $150 after pricing at $135: Live updates … SpaceX opened trading Friday at $150 under the ticker SPCX after the biggest initial public offering ever. — At $150, SpaceX is valued at just under $2 trillion, making it the sixth-most valuable U.S. company, ahead of Meta and Tesla.
